scope: Exact source-equation/per-bit Boolean selection certificate plus actual-role reset inventory. NOT full RTL/netlist formal equivalence or universal initialization simulation.

first_defined_contract.read_sample_edge: R, r_ce_in qualified at selected bank
first_defined_contract.defined_iff: Selected logical row has received a complete common1024-bit write strictly before this sample; no value obligation for unwritten-row reads.
first_defined_contract.output_edge: visible after R+1; downstream sequential consumer can sample at R+2
first_defined_contract.no_cycle_warmup: Checks start at each row/bank first defined read, not fixedcycle136 or global full preload.
first_defined_contract.memory_behavior: Actual physical model: read-before-write when CE read/write same row on same edge. Read of previously uninitialized row concurrent with first write is undefined; next read is defined.
first_defined_contract.Liberty_phase: Actual rd_out timing arc rising_edge and input setup_rising/hold_rising. Liberty does not independently specify collision data value.
source_equations: AtR: t1_bank<=requested_bank; all16select copies<=onehot(requested_bank); selected SRAM rd_out<=prewrite row word.
AtR+1: legacy t2_bank<=t1_bank and btcap<=rd; candidate each16bitq<=OR of rd_i AND onehot_i.
For arbitrary other-bank rd bits and arbitrary prior selection/output FF state, afterR+1 both yield the selected prewrite word.
first_defined_contract.write_obligation: Each tw_kind2 write updates all256bits in all4banks at tw_addr[8:2], full1024-bit group; no partial-write initialization assumption.

typed_no_reset_inventory.macro_functional_event: posedge clk only; row/column repair inputs are constant0, not reset
typed_no_reset_inventory.framework_typed_receipt: No new framework reset-proof override or waived receipt manufactured. No-reset source/native role inventory is the asserted scope.

capacity.parent_replica_scope: Single BTAB leaf only. Parent BTAB/BSCALE duplicate readers may require two leaves/32KiB aggregate physical; parent multiplicity/replica ratio not qualified here.

parent_scope: No global full-table boot/install guarantee is asserted. Parent must prove every consumed read references an initialized row and honors fixed read age; unused/uninstalled rows remain arbitrary. This is a required interface obligation, not an allowed implicit zero fill.
